description: Applies the requested operating configuration to entangled-photon sources, associated attenuators, and optional clock settings, and returns the applied parameter values.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Identifiers of every source, attenuator, and clock device locked for this configuration.

items.description: One device identifier reserved for this configuration.

sources.description: Entangled-photon source device configurations to apply.

items.description: One source device and its requested operating parameters.

attenuators.description: Attenuator device configurations associated with the sources.

items.description: One attenuator device and its requested parameter value.

clock.description: Optional pump and reference-clock configuration for the source devices.

settleSec.description: Delay after applying the requested operating state, in seconds.

device.configuration.applied.sourceSetup.description: Requested source settings and the corresponding device parameter read-backs.

device.configuration.applied.pumpFrequen.description: Pump frequency applied during this configuration, when specified.
